title: nymphoides forbesiana
intro: Nymphoides forbesiana, commonly known as the water fringed pink or yellow water lily, is a plant species native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. It is a rhizomatous aquatic plant with pink or yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and it has been used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Nymphoides forbesiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
